name: Cafe Schatzi Kitzbühel
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Café Schatzi in Kitzbühel** – a cozy gem nestled in the heart of the **Alpenland Tirol**. Just a short stroll from the charming **Kitzbüheler Horn**, this beloved café invites you to savor the finest **Kaiserschmarrn**, freshly baked **Apfelstrudel**, and aromatic **Kaffee** while soaking in the alpine ambiance.

Whether you’re here for a quick **Jause** or a leisurely afternoon, our warm hospitality and homemade treats promise a taste of **Tirol** at its best. Don’t miss our seasonal specialties—like **Topfenknödel** with caramelized onions—served with a smile and a view of the **Kitzbüheler Alpen**.

**Come by and let us spoil you!** ☕️🍰
